meta.name: add-sub
meta.description: Subscribe to a skill event. Adds a subscription that injects context before or after a skill runs. Supports optional conditions at both insert-level (inherited by all subscriptions) and subscription-level (AND-stacked). Conditions include fileExists, gitBranch, envSet, envEquals, fileContains (with optional regex).

copy.tagline: 订阅技能事件，在运行前后注入上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在其他技能执行前后自动执行自定义逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Subscribe to skill events and inject context before or after execution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run custom logic before or after other skills execute

howto.what: 安装后，你可以让 Claude 订阅某个技能事件，在技能运行前后自动注入上下文。支持按文件存在、Git 分支、环境变量等条件控制触发。
howto.when: 当你需要为某个技能添加订阅，或通过 `/skill-bus:add-sub` 命令直接启动交互流程时触发。

say.text: 订阅技能“code-review”在运行前注入上下文
say.note: Claude 会启动订阅流程，让你配置条件和上下文。

say.text: 添加一个订阅，条件为当前分支是 main
say.note: Claude 会引导你设置 gitBranch 条件。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can subscribe to a skill event to inject context before or after the skill runs. Supports conditions like file existence, Git branch, environment variables, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add a subscription for a skill, or by running the `/skill-bus:add-sub` command directly.

say_en.text: Subscribe to skill 'code-review' to inject context before it runs.
say_en.note: Claude starts the subscription flow to configure conditions and context.

say_en.text: Add a subscription with condition that current branch is main.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to set the gitBranch condition.
